```{r setup, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(foreach)
```

## Load CCEI programs

```{r load-ccei-programs}
# Programs from Polisson et al. 2020
programs_dir <- here("4_Code", "programs_polisson_etal_2020")

source(file.path(programs_dir, "ccei_garp.R"))
source(file.path(programs_dir, "garp.R"))
source(file.path(programs_dir, "warshall.R"))
```

## Prepare data

```{r prepare-decision-blocks, message = FALSE}
online_decision_tasks <- read_csv(here("1_Data", "2_processed", "Data_decision_task_online.csv"))

garp_input <- online_decision_tasks %>%
  select(participant_code, block_number, to_goal1, to_goal2, to_goal1_max, to_goal2_max)

# One data frame of choices per participant-decision block
garp_blocks <- split(garp_input, list(garp_input$participant_code, garp_input$block_number), drop = TRUE)
```

## Compute CCEI

```{r ccei-function}
# CCEI of one block; prices are 1 / maximum attainable amount, so every budget line sums to 1
run_garp <- function(block) {
  prices <- rbind(1 / block$to_goal2_max, 1 / block$to_goal1_max)
  quantities <- rbind(block$to_goal2, block$to_goal1)
  data.frame(participant_code = block$participant_code[1],
             task_number = block$block_number[1],
             ccei = ccei_garp(prices, quantities))
}
```

```{r ccei-all-blocks}
# Run in parallel, leaving one core free
cl <- makeCluster(max(1, detectCores() - 1))
registerDoParallel(cl)

results_list <- foreach(block = garp_blocks) %dopar% run_garp(block)

stopCluster(cl)

results <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  arrange(participant_code, task_number)
```

## Export

```{r export-ccei}
write_csv(results, here("1_Data", "2_processed", "GARP_results_online_sample.csv"))
```
